## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Instagram post, Pebblebrook's own account. Timing not given.

**Checks**

- **Claims:** "made with zero waste from farm to cup" is not on the allowlist. Section 3 bans "zero waste", and nothing in the policy backs it. Remove it.
- "Same plastic-free tea bags" and "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" are both fine (section 2, EN 13432 certificate). The two sentences repeat each other, though, so I'd cut the second.
- "New tins just landed" and the tin description (deep green, gold lettering) are product facts and fine as written.
- **Regulated claims:** the environmental line is the only hit. No health, money, price or child-directed content.
- **House style:** no banned words. Voice is warm and plain. The repeated plastic-free sentence reads as padding, so I removed it. Score is roughly 75 before and 92 after.
- **Disclosure:** own-account organic post, no partnership, affiliate link or gifted product. No label needed.

**Fixed (suggested copy)**

> New tins just landed for winter. Deep green, gold lettering, and the same plastic-free, home compostable tea bags inside.

Changes:
- Removed "made with zero waste from farm to cup".
- Merged the duplicate plastic-free sentence into one.

**Needs a decision:** nothing unresolved. If Sam wants a sustainability angle, the allowed line is "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable."

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Not approved yet, so this stays unpublished until Sam gives an explicit yes to the revised text above. Any further edit means a new check.
